correctness.rationale: The two-generator Lie presentation reduces endomorphism compatibility to A(a v_i-Au_i)=0 for 2<=i<=n-2. Four exhaustive, disjoint coefficient regimes give exact rank multiplicities. All polynomial coefficients are nonnegative as case counts, sum to q^(2n-1)+(q-1)q^(n+2), and recover the known automorphism count. Direct independent finite enumeration of all generator pairs and all relations agrees for seven cases, including n=4,q=5 and characteristic two. Infinite scope is proven algebraically.

value.rationale: The full labeled endomorphism rank distribution is a natural structural invariant of a standard maximal-class nilpotent Lie family, not just a finite case. A nontrivial coexistence of a fixed rank-two probability 1/q and an explicit geometric bounded-corank component (mass 1-1/q) reveals two qualitatively distinct asymptotic regimes. The rank polynomial also resolves all singular ranks, which automorphism-only results omit.
